market_sources.name: OWASP Credential Stuffing Prevention Cheat Sheet
OWASP Content Security Policy Cheat Sheet

records.label: Overview Cards (Site Gate / Active Rules / Recent Blocks / Login Protection / Recovery Readiness / Proxy Health / XML-RPC / Warnings / Rate Limiter / Latest Change / Log Retention)
records.notes: Computed summaries only; block counts are aggregate and never expose raw IPs, usernames or request bodies to the card. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §2.1.

records.label: Quick Actions (Enable Site Gate / Create Rule / Review Lockout Risk / Test Current Access / Recovery Instructions / View Logs)
records.notes: Each action opens its own preview-first flow behind capability checks; no quick action publishes enforcement directly. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §2.1.

records.label: Review Lockout Risk Action
records.notes: Runs the publish preflight against the current operator, known administrators, login and recovery routes and reports risk before any change. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §2.1, §16.

records.label: Rules List Columns (Name / Status / Priority / Scope / Subject / Effect / Schedule / Hits / Last Matched / Health / Actions)
records.notes: Hit count is optional and retention-aware; conflict/health column surfaces precedence conflicts. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §2.2.

records.label: Rules List Filters (Enabled / Effect / Resource Class / Subject Type / Scheduled / Conflicts / Date)
records.notes: Filters cover allow/deny/challenge/redirect effects and site/frontend/admin/login/REST/custom resource classes. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §2.2.

records.label: Row Actions (Edit / Duplicate / Test-Simulate / Enable-Disable / View Matches / Export / Archive-Delete)
records.notes: Enable and publish go through the lockout preflight; delete is capability-separated. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §2.2, §18.

records.label: Bulk Actions (Safe-Group Enable/Disable / Archive / Export)
records.notes: Bulk enable/disable only for safe groups; no bulk high-risk recovery or login-alias action. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §2.2.

records.label: Site Gate Mode (Off / Shared Password / Authentication / Role-Capability / Membership-Entitlement / Combined Policy / Maintenance-Private)
records.notes: Off by default; enabling any mode runs the lockout preflight and shows recovery instructions first. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3, §16.

records.label: Maintenance / Private-Site Custom Renderer
records.notes: Renderer content is local and escaped; gate page carries noindex and private/no-store cache headers. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3, §4, §5.

records.label: Scope: Entire Frontend
records.notes: Whole-frontend gating; admin and recovery routes stay reachable. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3.

records.label: Scope: Selected Post Types
records.notes: Uses registered post types only. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3.

records.label: Scope: Selected Routes / Path Groups
records.notes: Normalized path matching shared with the rule engine. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3, §5.

records.label: Scope: REST Unaffected by Default
records.notes: REST is excluded unless explicitly included with an impact preview, so Gutenberg/builders keep working. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3, §14.

records.label: Scope: Feeds / Search / Sitemaps
records.notes: Each is an explicit scope toggle shown in preview. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3.

records.label: Scope: Direct Media Only Where Protector Owns/Proxies Delivery
records.notes: Never claims protection of public static files it cannot intercept; the limitation is shown in the UI. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3, §23.

records.label: Exclusion: Login / Lost-Password / Recovery Session
records.notes: Login, lost-password and the current admin/recovery session are excluded by default so recovery is always possible. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3, §16.

records.label: Exclusion: Health / Loopback Endpoints
records.notes: WordPress loopback/health endpoints stay reachable when safely identifiable. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3.

records.label: Exclusion: Payment / Webhook Callbacks via Explicit Adapters Only
records.notes: Never a blanket bypass; owner adapters (Surface 23 Connections, payment providers) declare callback routes. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3.

records.label: Exclusion: robots / Sitemap When Configured Public
records.notes: Optional and visible in preview. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3.

records.label: Exclusion: Selected IP Networks / Paths / Resources
records.notes: IP exclusions are supplemental and resolve client IP through the trusted-proxy resolver. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3, §11, §12.

records.label: Every Exclusion Visible in Preview
records.notes: Preview lists all effective exclusions before the gate is enabled. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3.

records.label: Noindex for Protected Site
records.notes: On by default while gated. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4.

records.label: Gate Page Response Code
records.notes: 401/403/503 by mode semantics; maintenance may send Retry-After. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4, §5.

records.label: Set / Replace / Confirm Password (Never Revealed)
records.notes: Existing password is never revealed; replacement requires confirmation. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4.

records.label: One-Way Password Hash Storage
records.notes: Hashed with the WordPress password library; plaintext never stored in options, logs or exports. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4.

records.label: Optional Hint with Exposure Warning
records.notes: Warns against password-derived hints. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4.

records.label: Gate Session Duration (Default Candidate 24h) / Remember Access
records.notes: Bounded duration; remember toggle optional. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4.

records.label: Gate Cookie Flags (Automatic Scope / Secure on HTTPS / HttpOnly / SameSite Lax)
records.notes: Safest automatic path/domain scope; flags not weakenable in beginner mode. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4.

records.label: Invalidate All Gate Sessions (Session Generation)
records.notes: Bumping the generation invalidates every remembered gate session. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4.

records.label: Max Failed Attempts / Failure Window / Temporary Block Duration
records.notes: Temporary blocks only; shared rate service storage. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4, §10.

records.label: CAPTCHA Adapter After Threshold
records.notes: Optional registered adapter; no provider is called by default. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4.

records.label: Bypass Authenticated Administrators (Dedicated Capability)
records.notes: On by default via wpe_protector_bypass so admins are never gated out. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4, §18.

records.label: Gate Title / Message / Local Logo / Footer-Privacy Link
records.notes: Safe local media only; escaped output. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4.

records.label: Rule Identity (Name / Key / Enabled / Description)
records.notes: Stable key for portability and audit. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Rule Priority
records.notes: Feeds specificity-aware precedence. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5, §6.

records.label: Rule Tags
records.notes: Organizational only. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Scope: Exact Path / Prefix / Bounded Wildcard
records.notes: Normalized path matching; no unbounded patterns. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Normalized Path Matching (No Raw Host Header Semantics)
records.notes: Untrusted Host header never selects scope. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Scope: Post / Post Type / Taxonomy / Term
records.notes: Registered WordPress resources. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Scope: WPE Dashboard Route
records.notes: Surface 13 routes as registered. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Scope: wp-admin Screen / Route Group
records.notes: Route-aware; see admin compatibility. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5, §7.

records.label: Scope: Login Surface
records.notes: Never blocks the recovery path. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5, §16.

records.label: Scope: REST Route Family / Exact Route (Outer Policy Only)
records.notes: Outer deny/rate only; endpoint permission callbacks stay canonical (Surface 22). Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5, §14.

records.label: Scope: Registered Ability Action
records.notes: Registered Abilities only. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Scope: XML-RPC Delegated Policy Reference
records.notes: Reference into Surface 29; no duplicate truth. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5, §15.

records.label: Scope: Custom SDK-Registered Resource Type
records.notes: Registered resource types only. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Subject: Anonymous / Authenticated
records.notes: Core authentication state. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Subject: Specific Users / Roles / Capabilities
records.notes: Composes with Policy and Surface 30 Roles truth. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Subject: Membership Plans / Entitlements / Team Membership
records.notes: Surface 15 truth. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Subject: IP / CIDR / Trusted Network Group
records.notes: Supplemental, not identity; resolved through the trusted-proxy resolver. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §1, §5, §11.

records.label: Subject: Bounded Policy-Derived Principal Group
records.notes: Only if bounded. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Condition: Request Method
records.notes: Safe fact. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Condition: Site / Network Scope
records.notes: Multisite-aware. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Condition: Schedule / Time Window
records.notes: UTC stored, local rendered. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Condition: Selected Request Headers via Allowlisted Predicates
records.notes: No free-form header expressions. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Condition: Environment Flag (Staging / Production)
records.notes: From configured environment type. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Condition: Remembered Gate Session
records.notes: Gate session generation aware. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Effect: Deny
records.notes: Explicit deny wins at same specificity. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5, §6.

records.label: Effect: Allow (Protector Layer Only)
records.notes: An Allow never bypasses an earlier WordPress/core/WPE capability denial. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §1, §5.

records.label: Effect: Require Authentication
records.notes: Redirects to login with a validated local return URL. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Effect: Require Site Gate Password
records.notes: Shared gate semantics. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4, §5.

records.label: Effect: Redirect to Login / Local Page
records.notes: Local targets validated; loop detection. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5, §16.

records.label: Effect: Conceal as 404
records.notes: Presentation choice, not authorization. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Effect: Custom Protected Renderer / Message
records.notes: Escaped local content. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Effect: Rate-Limit / Challenge via Registered Adapter
records.notes: Adapters registered explicitly. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5, §10.

records.label: Response Status (401 / 403 / 404 / 429 by Semantic)
records.notes: 429 for rate limits. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: External Redirect (Advanced, Off by Default, Allowlist)
records.notes: Allowlisted hosts only; prevents open redirects. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: JSON Error for REST / API
records.notes: Standard WP_Error-shaped JSON. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Retry-After for Rate Limits
records.notes: Where applicable. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5, §10.

records.label: Cache-Control private / no-store for Sensitive Responses
records.notes: Prevents caching of gated content. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: No Sensitive Policy Details to Anonymous Visitors
records.notes: Generic messages only. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Schedule (Always / Start-End UTC / Recurring Windows / Weekdays / Maintenance Window)
records.notes: Rendered in site timezone. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: DST Preview
records.notes: Shows DST transitions. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Expired Rules Stay Visible / Disabled
records.notes: Never silently deleted. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Precedence Order (Recovery Bypass / Platform Safety / Exact / Subresource / Broader / Defaults)
records.notes: Deterministic order. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §6.

records.label: Explicit Deny Wins at Same Specificity
records.notes: Unless a dedicated recovery override applies. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §6.

records.label: Admin Simulation (Matched Rules / Normalized Request / Subject Facts / Winning Rule / Decision / Response)
records.notes: Read-only simulation; no enforcement side effects. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §6, §19.

records.label: Simulation Shows Outer WordPress / Module Policy Result
records.notes: Where available. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §6.

records.label: Admin Restriction Mode (None Default / Login Informational / Capability Screens / High-Risk Screens)
records.notes: No additional restriction by default. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §7.

records.label: Selected Screen / Action Restrictions with Subject Policy
records.notes: Capability-based. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §7.

records.label: Menu Visibility Delegated to Admin Menu Builder
records.notes: Presentation owned by Surface 11; hiding is not authorization. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §1, §7.

records.label: AJAX Action Allow/Deny via Registered Adapter Metadata Only
records.notes: admin-ajax.php and admin-post.php are never disabled globally. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §7.

records.label: Compatibility Warnings (Blanket /wp-admin, admin-ajax, admin-post, REST)
records.notes: Shown before publish. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §7.

records.label: Recovery Administrator Exemption
records.notes: Recovery admin always retains access. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §7, §16.

records.label: Network Admin Separately Governed
records.notes: Super Admin context respected. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §7.

records.label: Audit Denied Admin Requests
records.notes: Privacy-aware log fields. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §7, §17.

records.label: Enable Login Alias (Noise Reduction, Off by Default)
records.notes: Positioned as noise reduction only, never as authentication. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §1, §8.

records.label: Alias Slug Validation (Reserved Paths / Slug Conflicts / Redirect Loop / Characters)
records.notes: Alias cannot equal blocked original route semantics. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §8.

records.label: Original wp-login.php Direct Navigation Behavior
records.notes: POST/auth mechanics preserved. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §8.

records.label: Lost-Password / Register / Logout / Reset-Key URL Rewrites
records.notes: All core flows keep working. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §8, §23.

records.label: Multisite / Network Login Handling
records.notes: Network-aware. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §8.

records.label: WooCommerce / XML-RPC / Application Passwords / REST Unaffected
records.notes: Unless explicitly integrated by owner. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §8.

records.label: Alias Change Requires Re-Auth + Recovery Instructions
records.notes: Recovery instructions shown before save. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §8, §16.

records.label: Compatibility Test Status
records.notes: Reported before activation. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §8.

records.label: Failed-Login Limiting
records.notes: Temporary blocks only; never a permanent automatic ban. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §9.

records.label: Attempt Count / Rolling-Fixed Window / Temporary Block Duration
records.notes: Conservative defaults. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §9.

records.label: Identifier Key (IP / Username+IP / Account-Sensitive)
records.notes: Account-sensitive keys avoid locking a real user out because of attackers; IP from trusted-proxy resolver. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §9, §11.

records.label: Normalized Unknown-User Behavior (Anti-Enumeration)
records.notes: Same response for unknown and wrong-password. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §9.

records.label: Trusted Network Bypass (Optional)
records.notes: Off by default. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §9, §12.

records.label: Administrator Lockout Policy (Recovery Path Required)
records.notes: Administrators are never locked out without a documented recovery path. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §9, §16.

records.label: CAPTCHA / Challenge Adapter Threshold
records.notes: Optional adapter. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §9.

records.label: Suspicious-Threshold Notification
records.notes: Delivered via Surface 19 Notifications. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §9.

records.label: Block List (Search / Pagination / Reset Block)
records.notes: Reset requires capability. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §9.

records.label: Block Record Retention
records.notes: Bounded. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §9, §17.

records.label: Shared Rate-Limit Service (Canonical Storage / Algorithm Owner)
records.notes: Surface 27 owns rate storage/algorithm; Surface 22 REST profiles (rest-api.rate.limit), Surface 29 XML-RPC and Surface 17/21/23 owners consume it. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §10; docs/PRODUCT/PROTECTOR-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md.

records.label: Targets (Login / Site Gate / REST Route / Ability / XML-RPC / Form / Chat / Webhook Receive / Custom)
records.notes: Webhook receive only where the owner adapter permits. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §10.

records.label: Key Strategy
records.notes: Principal/IP/route keys; IP via trusted-proxy resolver; keys hashed in logs. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §10, §17.

records.label: Limit / Interval-Window / Burst
records.notes: Burst only if algorithm supports it. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §10.

records.label: Temporary Block Duration
records.notes: Always bounded. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §10.

records.label: Response Code (429) / Retry-After Behavior
records.notes: RFC 6585 semantics. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §10.

records.label: Subject Bypass / Trusted Networks
records.notes: Explicit and logged. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §10.

records.label: Logging Sampling
records.notes: Bounded writes. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §10, §22.

records.label: Storage Backend Health (No Strict Distributed Promise)
records.notes: UI never promises strict distributed limits unless the backend supports them. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §10.

records.label: Concurrency Correctness
records.notes: Required after implementation consent. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §10, §23.

records.label: Client IP Default: Direct Remote Address Only
records.notes: Forwarded headers ignored by default. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §11.

records.label: Trusted Proxy CIDR List
records.notes: Forwarded headers parsed only from listed proxies. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §11.

records.label: Forwarding Header from Allowlist (X-Forwarded-For / Forwarded / Provider Adapter)
records.notes: One selected header per deployment. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §11.

records.label: Trusted Hop Strategy
records.notes: Walks the chain from the nearest trusted proxy; untrusted left-most values ignored. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §11.

records.label: Test Current Request Chain / Resolved IP Diagnostics
records.notes: Displayed safely to authorized admins. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §11.

records.label: Invalid / Spoofed Header Ignored
records.notes: Malformed values fall back to the direct address. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §11, §23.

records.label: Named Network Groups (Name / Notes / Enabled / Usage Count)
records.notes: Reusable across rules. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §12.

records.label: IPv4 / IPv6 / CIDR Entries with Overlap / Duplicate Validation
records.notes: Validated on save. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §12.

records.label: Optional Entry Expiration
records.notes: Expired entries stop matching. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §12.

records.label: Import with Preview / Invalid Report / Dedupe
records.notes: Manual import only; no remote feed. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §12.

records.label: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
records.notes: Low-risk preset. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §13.

records.label: Referrer-Policy Selection
records.notes: Advisory preset. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §13.

records.label: Permissions-Policy Structured Directives
records.notes: Structured, not raw. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §13.

records.label: Frame Protection (CSP frame-ancestors Preferred / X-Frame-Options Legacy)
records.notes: Compatibility note shown. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §13.

records.label: HSTS (HTTPS-Safe Opt-In / max-age / includeSubDomains / Preload Warnings)
records.notes: Never auto-enabled; preload requires explicit acknowledgement. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §13.

records.label: CSP Report-Only First / Enforce Advanced (Structured Directives)
records.notes: Report-Only precedes enforcement; beginner mode never concatenates arbitrary strings. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §13.

records.label: CSP Report Endpoint Only if Receiver Exists
records.notes: No dangling report-uri. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §13.

records.label: Header Scope (Frontend / Admin)
records.notes: Per-scope presets. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §13.

records.label: Duplicate / Upstream Server-CDN Header Detection
records.notes: Warns when headers already set upstream. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §13, §21.

records.label: Resulting Header Preview Before Enforcement
records.notes: Preview of the exact headers before publish. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §13.

records.label: Outer Deny Route Family
records.notes: Cannot grant what the route permission callback denies. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §14.

records.label: Require Extra Subject / Policy
records.notes: Additive only. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §14.

records.label: REST Rate-Limit Policy
records.notes: Consumes the shared rate service. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §10, §14.

records.label: Log Denied REST Attempts
records.notes: Privacy-aware. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §14, §17.

records.label: Disable Discovery Exposure Only if Semantically Safe
records.notes: Impact-reviewed. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §14.

records.label: Route Impact Preview (Dependent Modules / Builders)
records.notes: Warns on Gutenberg-heavy sites. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §14.

records.label: XML-RPC Delegated Summary / Deep Link
records.notes: Surface 29 owns XML-RPC truth. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §15.

records.label: Recovery Admin Capability / Session
records.notes: Required before high-risk activation. Evidence: docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §16, §18.

coverage.notes: All 225 Protector records are classified from docs/MODULES/PROTECTOR-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md and docs/PRODUCT/PROTECTOR-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md (170 WPE_HARD, 13 NATIVE_HARD, 11 SOFT_NATIVE, 4 WPE_EXCEED, 6 DEFERRED and 21 REJECTED_UNSAFE). Native login/auth/redirect/capability/nonce/header/REST/session/password/recovery-mode/multisite primitives are request substrate only; Protector is fail-safe: Site Gate and login alias are off by default, administrators keep a dedicated bypass and every high-risk publish runs a lockout preflight with a documented wp-config safe-disable recovery path; client IP is the direct remote address unless forwarded headers come from configured trusted proxies; logs are privacy-minimized with bounded retention, IP truncation and no third-party IP lookups by default; headers are previewed and CSP starts Report-Only; Surface 27 owns the shared rate-limit service consumed by Surface 22. 6 items are deferred and 21 unsafe patterns stay rejected.
